title: Saudi Arabia–Yemen boundary treaty
description: Treaty entered into force after signature on 12 June. The timeline starts at year-end 2000, after this settlement.

title: Bahrain–Qatar territorial judgment
description: The ICJ determined sovereignty over disputed islands and a maritime boundary. No separate pre/post-judgment geometry is bundled.

title: Eritrea–Ethiopia boundary decision
description: The commission delimited the boundary. The decision did not immediately settle physical control; the source does not encode a year-specific polygon change.

title: Timor-Leste becomes independent
description: East Timor is shown under UN administration in 2000–2001 and as independent Timor-Leste from 2002.

title: Cameroon–Nigeria boundary judgment
description: The ICJ settled the boundary. Subsequent handovers occurred in stages, separately from this legal decision. No year-specific transfer polygons are bundled.

title: Yugoslavia renamed Serbia and Montenegro
description: The map label changes; this was not a territorial split.

title: Kazakhstan–Uzbekistan border treaties take effect
description: Treaties signed in 2001 and 2002 entered into force. The source does not include distinct before/after outlines for these settlements.

title: Lake Chad transfer of authority
description: Nigeria transferred authority in the Lake Chad area to Cameroon. This stage is documented but has no separate geometry in the bundle.

title: Cameroon–Nigeria land-boundary handovers
description: Transfers of authority along the land boundary took place in 2004. No year-specific transfer polygons are bundled.

title: China–Russia boundary agreement signed
description: The agreement was ratified in 2005; remaining demarcation followed later. A signature is not encoded as an immediate transfer of control.

title: Indonesia–Timor-Leste provisional boundary takes effect
description: The agreement, signed 8 April, covered approximately 96% of the land boundary. The source has no distinct 2005 boundary revision.

title: Benin–Niger river-boundary judgment
description: The ICJ determined the river boundary and island sovereignty, including Lété Goungou for Niger. No separate before/after island geometry is bundled.

title: Poland–Slovakia small border exchanges
description: An agreement signed in 2002 entered into force, adjusting three border sections. These small exchanges are not encoded in the source.

title: Kazakhstan–Russia border treaty takes effect
description: The treaty signed in January 2005 entered into force. This formal delimitation is not represented as a separate polygon change.

title: Montenegro becomes independent
description: The former union is shown as separate Serbia and Montenegro in the 2006 year-end snapshot.

title: Serbia confirms succession to the union
description: Serbia continues the international legal identity and UN membership of Serbia and Montenegro.

title: Bakassi withdrawal and transfer agreement
description: The Greentree Agreement set out staged withdrawal and transfer arrangements. Remaining authority was transferred in 2008; the entire peninsula is not treated as an immediate 2006 handover.
